verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a documented webhooks API: the developer docs webhooks page includes a 'Get all webhooks in an account' endpoint, which implies registrable outbound webhooks. Nothing in the evidence shows which events can be subscribed to or how payloads are structured or secured. Missing for 10: confirmation that sends, opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes can be subscribed to, a documented payload schema, signed-payload verification (e.g. HMAC), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
